description: Client-side script for 'Assessment Result Tool' form in ERPNext, handling assessment data fetching, rendering, scoring, and submission.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for the form, adding fetch for student group.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes form, sets values based on route options, disables save, clears indicators.

methods.name: assessment_plan
methods.description: Fetches students for the assessment plan and student group, updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: render_table
methods.description: Clears previous results and fetches assessment details to render the results table.

methods.name: get_marks
methods.description: Calculates total scores, renders assessment results table, handles score input changes, and updates assessment results.

methods.name: submit_result
methods.description: Handles submission of assessment results when the form is ready.
